resources.string: Uses app-change events to check the foreground app. After consent, captures the visible screen during phone or desktop runs only while an app you approved is in the foreground. Overlapping windows can appear in a capture. ML Kit reads text locally after keyboard masking. Screenshot images stay in memory. Extracted text goes to TypeSafe for Jev analysis when configured. Desktop runs send summaries and detection results. Raw screen text and voice conversation text are not logged. Automatic voice warnings require separate consent. The microphone runs only during a voice conversation.
